report:
Left kidney, partial nephrectomy

Received in formalin is a left partial nephrectomy specimen weighing 62 g and measuring 5.5 x 4.5 x 4.0 cm. Sectioning reveals a 32 mm (32 x 28 x 24 mm) tumour in the lower pole, well-circumscribed mahogany-brown solid mass. Sections are submitted in 8 blocks.

(A1-A6) tumour with inked parenchymal margin.
(A7-A8) adjacent renal cortex.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Partial nephrectomy
- Specimen laterality: Left
- Tumour focality: Unifocal
- Tumour site: Lower pole
- Tumour size (greatest dimension): 32 mm (32 x 28 x 24 mm)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Chromophobe renal cell carcinoma
- Histologic grade (WHO/ISUP): Not applicable
- Sarcomatoid features: Not identified
- Rhabdoid features: Not identified
- Tumour necrosis: Not identified
- Lymphovascular invasion (excluding renal vein / IVC): Not identified
- Tumour extension: Limited to kidney
- Tumour histology:
  Sections of the kidney show chromophobe renal cell carcinoma. Solid sheets of pale polygonal and eosinophilic cells display prominent plant-like cell membranes, raisinoid nuclei and perinuclear haloes. CD117 and CK7 diffuse strongly positive; CAIX negative.

Margins
- Surgical margins: All margins uninvolved by invasive carcinoma
- Distance to closest margin: 2 mm (parenchymal margin)

Pathological stage (AJCC 8th edition)
- pTNM: pT1a

Additional findings
- Non-neoplastic kidney: Arterionephrosclerosis / vascular disease

LEFT KIDNEY, partial nephrectomy:
- CHROMOPHOBE RENAL CELL CARCINOMA, 32 mm
- Confined to the kidney
- Surgical margins clear (closest 2 mm, parenchymal margin)
- pT1a (AJCC 8th edition).
